findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_site, check_url, verify_mcp, register_monitor · Private data: get_site_details, record_action_interest, prepare_provider_action, handoff_provider_action · Public sink: submit_site, register_monitor, prepare_provider_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_site, check_url, verify_mcp, register_monitor · Private data: get_site_details, record_action_interest, prepare_provider_action, handoff_provider_action · Public sink: submit_site, register_monitor, prepare_provider_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_site_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
